title: The Painted Ledger
author: Marguerite Nakamura
blurb: Ivo Villalobos, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the statute expires.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
